messages:
samops: Rolling out a Private Certificate Rotation Policy for Private/VPC and on-prem customers. Effective immediately, vendors/agents will rotate attestation certs every 90 days. Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/private-cert-rotation :lock:

hannah_product: Short summary for AEs: this improves key freshness for attestation and reduces risk of long-lived cert compromise. Customers on agent v3.0+ will be able to auto-roll; older agents need manual rotation.

leo_security: Important: auto-roll requires outbound reachability for the agent callback endpoint and a valid KMS binding. On-prem customers should confirm agent can reach 10.1.1.10:443 or use the offline rotation process in the doc.

maria_support: I'll publish a KB article with troubleshooting steps (rotation failures, cert mismatch, expired CA chain). @samops please add a snippet showing the manual CSR flow.

samops: Manual CSR example pasted in docs. Quick CLI for on-prem: `agent-cli rotate-cert --csr > new.csr && curl -X POST https://cid.redwood.local/rotate -d @new.csr -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'`

deploy-bot: Canary: private-agent rotation feature flag enabled in staging us-west-1 at 2026-04-10T02:00Z. Monitoring will alert on rollout failures.

leo_security: Policy note: existing customers will be contacted by CSMs before any enforced rotation. No billing impact. We're tracking HSM requests separately (if customers need hardware-backed keys).

hannah_product: Adding a one-paragraph blurb for the newsletter and updating the Private onboarding checklist. :memo:

samops: Thanks all. I'll post pilot list and first-week metrics here (success rate, failures) next Tuesday.
